item.tib: sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po
item.skt: bud+d+ha tsa ri ta ma hA kA bya nA ma
item.coloph: yul shA ke ta ka'i gser mig ma'i bu dge slong slob dpon snyan dngags mkhan chen po/ smra ba dang ldan pa phyogs su rnam par grags pa/ btsun pa rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa'i/ sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa zhes bya ba'i snyan dngags chen po las sku gdung rnam par bgo ba'i le'u ste/ nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa yongs su rdzogs so/ /sa steng rgya mtsho'i mthar thugs bstan pa'i bdag po'i mchog /yon tan mtshungs med phul byung du ma'i gter chen po/ mkhas pa rnams kyi bla ma skye dgu rnams kyi dpal/ bla ma dam pa chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' lung gis/ 'jig rten kun na zla bral skyes mchog de nyid kyi/ phrin las sgrub pa brnyes pa'i thugs dgongs rnam dag dang / mi rje lha sras gung thang rgyal mo yum sras dang / chos la gcig tu dkar ba'i lha cig kun dga' 'bum/ mang yul skyid rong bzo mo yon tan skyid la sogs/ chos ldan dam pa rnams kyis sbyin bdag bgyid pa'i ngor/ 'phags pa rta dbyangs kyis mdzad thub pa'i mdzad pa 'di/ sa dbang bzang po dang ni blo gros rgyal pos bsgyur
